intent: Top-of-page title with optional Breadcrumb trail, subtitle, and actions.
useWhen: Product page title with optional Breadcrumb trail and actions
Placing primary/secondary Buttons aligned to the page title
Page title with a search Input and one primary Button on the right
doNotUseWhen: Product top chrome with logo and search — use AppHeader
Path-only without a page title — use Breadcrumb

layout.note: Inside layout-header, PageHeader (its root is a header) is a flex item with basis 20rem that takes the free space, so siblings such as a Menu Button or a toolbar sit on the same row and wrap below it only when the row is narrower than 20rem plus their width. Alone it fills the row. Override the flex with className if you want something else.

eyebrow.note: Kept for existing call sites. Breadcrumbs replace eyebrow as the default where-am-I.

actions.note: Any node, laid out in a wrapping row, vertically centered: kit Buttons, a ButtonGroup, a search Input, a Select. At most one primary Button. A kit Input here sizes to its field (not full width), so it sits beside the Buttons; set a width with its className if you want one.

breadcrumbs.note: Same shape as Breadcrumb items. Rendered only when length >= 2. Passed through to kit Breadcrumb.

breadcrumbSeparator.note: Passed through to kit Breadcrumb separator.

breadcrumbMaxItems.note: Passed through to kit Breadcrumb maxItems.

doNot: Do not invent BreadcrumbItem or BreadcrumbLink cousins — compose kit Breadcrumb
Do not restyle Breadcrumb internals from PageHeader
Do not put more than one primary Button in actions (an Input or other controls beside it are fine)
snippet: <PageHeader title="Aurora" subtitle="Campaign settings and collaborators." breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Home", href: "#" }, { label: "Projects", href: "#" }, { label: "Aurora" }]} actions={<><Button variant="secondary">Edit</Button><Button>Save</Button></>} />
